meta.title: HSK 1 — Chinese to English
meta.subtitle: 150 words · recall the meaning and pinyin
meta.desc: Shown the characters, recall the English meanings and the pinyin. All 150 words of the official HSK 1 vocabulary list (HSK 2.0, the 2012 syllabus). Every card carries the simplified form, the traditional form, pinyin, bopomofo, the measure word where the word takes one, and the full range of English translations rather than a single gloss. Traditional characters are shown at half strength, and are omitted entirely where they are identical to the simplified — 82 of the 150 words. Each card also breaks the word into its characters, giving each one's reading, its meaning and the radical it is filed under, and carries a fold of real example sentences with the word underlined in each. Word list: the official HSK 2012 Level 1 syllabus. Definitions, readings and measure words: CC-CEDICT (CC BY-SA 4.0). Radicals and character meanings: Make Me a Hanzi. Example sentences: Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
